claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_aura (class-feature family)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Aura of Courage is an always-on class feature that projects an area-based benefit to allies inside an existing paladin aura. Current class-feature families only cover bearer-local passive grants or activated abilities with costs/resources; neither can honestly express an always-on aura affecting other creatures.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You and your allies have Immunity to the Frightened condition while in your Aura of Protection.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: class-feature aura scope attachment
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The missing piece is not the immunity atom itself, but a way for a class feature to reference a persistent named aura area rather than a spell-style cast-time attachment. The feature needs to say that the grant applies to creatures inside Aura of Protection's zone.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: while in your Aura of Protection. If a Frightened ally enters the aura, that condition has no effect on that ally while there.
